text: Yolanda is sitting on a chair talking to a young male nurse who is eager to sympathize, yet not quite listening. Her large bottom pushes it’s way through the back of the chair, and hangs over the side. She is Italian and her accent is apparent in her speech. “I uze to be so skeeny! I was beeautiful! My boyfriend, my beeautiful boyfriend, he uze to loove my body. But then it eez like this,” She gestures downwards, grabbing hold of a fold of skin and releasing it with dismay. Meanwhile the male nurse who is wearing a white shirt and white pants, a pen erect in his pocket, has been sitting at attention, nodding and murmuring at every word. Yolanda looks into the distance, only making eye contact now to make sure her point is understood.
